fields.Notes: On the basis of the decree of the Imperial-Royal Governor's Office of 6 January 1898 no. 88333 and of the order of the Imperial-Royal District Office in Grybow of the day 12 March 1898 no. 769 and of the day 1 June 1898 no. 5641, there is entered the following act of supplemental and matriculation of birth: Matla Wurzel gave birth in Siedliska in the year one thousand eight hundred seventy-first (1871) an illegitimate son; at the circumcision the name Moses was given. To the paternity of this child Leiser Kirsch declared himself, according to the certification of the registrar of Jewish records in Jaslo, of the day 14 July 1897 no. 43. The parents of this child contracted in Jaslo on the day 20 May year 1895 a subsequent marriage, which I attest is in the book of marriages of the Jewish matriculation district in Jaslo, volume III, pages 54-55, entry no. 28.

fields.Father (prose): Moses Kranz, shoemaker in Kamienica Dolna
fields.Mother (prose): Hinde Turk
fields.Notes: Baracha, the illegitimate daughter of Hinde Turk, was born in Kamienica Dolna, Pilzno district, in the year 1899, that is, in the one-thousand-eight-hundred-and-ninety-ninth year. Paternity of this child was acknowledged by Moses Kranz, who entered into a lawful marriage with the child's mother in the year 1902 in Jaslo, recorded in the marriage register of the Israelite metrical district in Jaslo for the year 1902, Volume III, page 170/1, entry no. 26; therefore, the child was legitimated by the subsequent marriage of the parents and is legally entitled to bear the father's family name "Kranz." The entry was made pursuant to a rescript of the county Office in Krakow dated 29 December 1931, reference SPD VI 1123/31, in Pilzno on 28 January 1932.

fields.Notes: On the basis of a rescript of the High Imperial-Royal Governorship dated 24 September 1901, no. 95859, and an order of the Imperial-Royal District Office in Pilzno dated 24 September of the same year, no. 1986, the following is entered: Hinde Kornhauser gave birth in Skurowa, in the month of January of the year one thousand eight hundred seventy-three (1873), to an illegitimate daughter, who at the time of blessing was given the name "Hannah". Note of the registrar. According to the above order, this additional immatriculation entry is to be made in 1873 of the book of births but it was not possible to enter this in 1873 because there was no space. Therefore it was placed here under current serial number and a report given to the district.

fields.Mother (prose): Esther Itta nee Sturm

translator_note: Blima Kichel's birth is not listed in the books of Brzostek. Her existence and her parents are inferred from US immigration records. 17 Sep 1920 aboard SS Aquitania to Ellis Island, Blima Kichel age 25 single female tailor, listed father Leiser Kichel in Brzostek as next of kin. Age 25 in Sep 1920 → born ~Sep 1894 to Sep 1895. Joseph Kichel (b-1895-25, 22 Aug 1895) was confirmed same family and also emigrated (SS Hamburg 5 Feb 1914). It is assumed that Blima and Joseph were siblings but cannot both be born in 1895 by natural gestation — Blima likely b.late 1894 (older sister) or born in Biecz/Rzepiennik before the family settled in Brzostek (Leiser from Rzepiennik Strzyżewski, Esther from Biecz per m-1896-2)
